purpose: New project snapshots for blinded human review; no labels supplied or inferred
selection: Per project, hash-sort C/H paths and select 16; independently hash-sort PEM/KEY paths and select up to 8. Scan those selected files, then hash-sort and sample up to 4 emitted and 4 no-finding files per project. Preserve original paths including test/example directories. No rule tuning after freeze.
exclusions: No builds, target execution, submodules, generated downloads, binary archives or source redistribution. Unknown labels remain unknown until two independent humans and adjudication.
leakage_check: Reject projects already named in tracked prior scan manifests and input digests in frozen regression fixtures. Review samples lose holdout status if later used to tune detectors.
ground_truth: pending independent human review; source licenses checked through official repository license endpoints
